title: Critique: heartbeat-based evidence for interoceptive selfhood is weak

statements.text: Evidence tying interoceptive sensitivity to body ownership rests on heartbeat tasks of doubtful validity, and a later study found no link between cardiac accuracy and the rubber hand illusion.

sources.quote: Cardioceptive accuracy, however, was not associated with the strength of the illusion.
We encourage researchers using this score for studying cognitive and emotional processes to reconsider its meaning.
